format.id: kebab-case agent id, unique in the registry
format.public_fingerprint: sha256 of the agent's PUBLIC profile (name + handle); NOT a secret, display-only local hash; never a key, token, or password
format.version: agent version label; editing creates a new version, pinned runs keep their version
format.created: ISO-8601 creation timestamp for real rows; EXAMPLE rows carry no real date
format.autonomy: integer 0-5, set by owner in UI, never raised by the agent itself
format.observer_read_only_note: observer-role agents are blocked from applying changes with reason=observer-read-only

duplicate_id_collision_rule: on save, if id already exists in the registry: block with reason=duplicate-id (this file's rule) and keep the existing row unchanged; never silently overwrite, never auto-merge. Site analogues: decision-log replayed id returns dup=true and changes nothing; artifact version collision is artifact-version-exists.

example_row.public_fingerprint: sha256-name-handle (format description from examples.al, NOT a computed hash)
